application_includes_its_helper_processe: Application includes its helper processes. The connection core and its child processes are counted separately. The core may stay running after disconnecting.
auto_http_s_tcp_icmp_stopping_at_the_fir: Auto: HTTP(S) → TCP → ICMP, stopping at the first success. Inapplicable methods are skipped. The timeout applies to each method separately. A VPN sign-in request or VPN connection without an HTTP response ends the test.
changes_apply_to_the_next_test_run_27284: Changes apply to the next test run.
could_not_prepare_a_private_geodata_copy: Could not prepare a private geodata copy for the test.
could_not_resolve_the_server_address_20b: Could not resolve the server address.
could_not_start_the_test_core_b7de8f1: Could not start the test core.
could_not_use_a_direct_network_interface: Could not use a direct network interface for the test.
cpu_100_is_the_capacity_of_all_logical_p: CPU: 100% is the capacity of all logical processors. RAM is the sum of resident memory; shared pages can be counted more than once.
download_geodata_in_xray_settings_first_: Download geodata in Xray settings first.
enter_an_http_s_url_without_credentials_: Enter an HTTP(S) URL without credentials or a # fragment.
http_method_hint: HTTP(S): request through the profile. Complete sing-box and Xray configurations use their own DNS and routing. For a VPN, waits up to {vpnStatusTimeoutSeconds} s for the connection to be ready before the HTTP request.
http_testing_uses_cached_geoip_geosite_c: HTTP testing uses cached GeoIP/GeoSite categories; external files are unsupported.
icmp_direct_echo_request_to_the_server_a: ICMP: direct echo request to the server. A working VPN server may not reply to ICMP.
icmp_is_unavailable_on_this_system_or_bl: ICMP is unavailable on this system or blocked by its permissions.
individual_openvpn_and_openconnect_profi: Individual OpenVPN and OpenConnect profiles with saved credentials are supported; a profile bound to an OTP entry gets its code baked into the test, and a bound HOTP spends one counter step per manual test. Composed VPN paths wait for their VPN hops. Any HTTP response counts as reachability.
last_minute_while_this_page_is_open_b574: Last minute while this page is open
messages_from_this_application_session_i: Messages from this application session, including core output and connection errors.
no_icmp_reply_the_server_or_network_may_: No ICMP reply. The server or network may block echo requests while the VPN still works.
no_log_messages_yet_they_appear_when_the: No log messages yet. They appear when the core starts or reports an error.
no_server_address_or_tcp_port_was_found_: No server address or TCP port was found in the configuration.
no_test_method_is_available_for_this_pro: No test method is available for this profile.
none_of_the_methods_received_a_successfu: None of the methods received a successful response.
process_metrics_are_currently_available_: Process metrics are available on Linux and Windows.
results_last_until_the_app_exits_and_are: Results last until the app exits and are invalidated when the profile configuration changes.
selection_and_timeout_range: Select 1–{maxBatchProfiles} profiles and a timeout of {probeTimeoutMsMin}–{probeTimeoutMsMax} ms.
some_processes_could_not_be_measured_val: Some processes could not be measured. Values are incomplete.
tcp_direct_connection_to_the_server_port: TCP: direct connection to the server port, without VPN authentication. Not applicable to UDP protocols.
tcp_is_not_applicable_this_profile_uses_: TCP is not applicable: this profile uses UDP.
tests_an_http_s_response_through_each_pr: Tests an HTTP(S) response through each profile separately, independently of global routing rules. The first successful request warms up the connection; the second is measured.
the_configuration_changed_or_the_profile: The configuration changed or the profile was deleted. Run a new test.
the_configuration_has_multiple_possible_: The configuration has multiple possible servers. Test an individual profile.
the_core_could_not_start_the_test_config: The core could not start the test configuration.
the_geodata_cache_is_invalid_update_it_i: The geodata cache is invalid. Update it in Xray settings.
the_server_did_not_respond_within_the_ti: The server did not respond within the timeout.
the_server_is_unreachable_using_this_met: The server is unreachable using this method.
the_server_refused_the_tcp_connection_to: The server refused the TCP connection to this port.
the_test_buttons_in_the_library_use_thes: The test buttons in the library use these settings. Each request goes through the selected profile.
the_test_could_not_finish_stopping_anoth: The test could not finish stopping. Another test cannot start yet.
the_vpn_connected_but_the_website_did_no: The VPN connected, but the website did not respond over HTTP(S). Latency was not measured.
the_vpn_is_connected_but_the_measurement: The VPN is connected, but the measurement failed. Check DNS and reachability of the test service.
this_full_json_uses_background_services_: This full JSON uses background services, special inbounds, external resources or group chains that this test does not support yet.
this_vpn_authentication_method_is_not_su: This VPN authentication method is not supported by URL testing yet. Use a regular connection.
visible_logs_hint: Up to {maxVisibleLogs} matching messages are shown. Buffer size and file output are configured in log settings.
url_testing_has_not_been_migrated_for_th: URL testing has not been migrated for this profile type yet.
vpn_authentication_is_required_check_the: VPN authentication is required. Check the saved credentials and use a regular connection to complete sign-in.
vpn_url_testing_is_available_for_an_indi: VPN URL testing is available for an individual OpenVPN or OpenConnect profile in local or system proxy mode on Linux.
wait_for_the_current_test_or_stop_it_115: Wait for the current test or stop it.
wireguard_endpoint_context_unsupported: IP, speed and HTTP tests cover an individual userspace WireGuard or AmneziaWG profile. A system interface, a named interface, a detour or group proxies are not supported yet.
measurement_journal_hint: Every latency, IP, speed and internet check with its outcome. Codes only: no URLs, keys or responses are stored.
measurement_journal_empty: No measurements have been recorded yet.
switch_history_hint: When an automatic pool changed which member carries traffic. Names only: no tags, keys or wire data are stored.
switch_history_empty: No member switches have been recorded yet.
probe_vpn_otp_binding_required: This profile expects a one-time code. Bind an OTP entry to it to test.
probe_vpn_otp_manual_only: Periodic and automatic checks do not spend one-time codes. Run the test manually.
probe_vpn_otp_failed: Could not reserve a one-time code for this test. See the log.
log_auto_select_source_deleted: Auto-select source group was deleted; using all groups
log_auto_select_source_reset: Auto-select source group was missing; using all groups
log_connection_restore_skipped_otp: Previous connection used a one-time code and is not restored
log_core_log_stream_failed: Core log stream closed with an I/O error
log_core_recovery_skipped_otp: Local core recovery skipped: the connection used a one-time code
log_core_recovery_stopped: Local core exits too frequently; automatic restart stopped
log_selector_rebuild_health_unreadable: Could not read automatic pool health for rebuilding
log_selector_rebuild_kept_previous: Could not rebuild the automatic pool; keeping the previous connection when available
log_selector_rebuild_started: Rebuilding automatic pool after all running servers failed
log_selector_subscription_applying: Applying subscription changes to the automatic pool
log_tray_routing_apply_failed: Tray routing was saved but could not be applied
log_tray_routing_save_failed: Tray routing could not be saved
log_selector_health_read_failed: Could not read saved pool health
log_auto_select_memory_write_failed: Could not save the remembered auto-select server
log_vpn_otp_start_stale: The connection used a one-time code and is not started again
log_switch_history_write_failed: Could not save the switch history
log_tray_reconnect_failed: The setting was changed but the connection was not restored
log_tray_setting_failed: Tray setting could not be changed
log_auto_clear_failed: Unavailable servers could not be removed
log_auto_clear_removed: Unavailable servers removed after the test
log_traffic_history_imported: Traffic history imported from an older copy
log_vpn_otp_restarted: Connection restarted with a fresh one-time code
log_session_end_cleanup_incomplete: Network settings were not fully restored before the session ended; the next launch finishes it
log_autostart_switched_off_in_windows: Autostart was switched off in Windows Task Manager; the setting now follows it
log_deeplink_foreign_handler_kept: The throne:// handler of another application was left in place; thronium:// links open here
log_qt_throne_running: Qt Throne is running; its system proxy, TUN or system DNS may interfere
log_tun_service_connected: Connected to the Thronium service for TUN
log_core_pair_mismatch: ThroniumCore beside the application is from another version
